rule.statement: A party is estopped from disputing a decision on the merits in a subsequent litigation on the basis of Res Judicata estoppel.
rule.supporting_quote: Where a competent court which has jurisdiction over the parties and the subject matter of a dispute, has pronounced final decision, any party to such litigation, or in the case of a decision in rem any party whomsoever, as against any other party, is estopped from disputing such a decision on the merits in a subsequent litigation on the basis of Res Judicata estoppel.
